headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas advises GRID-INDIA on acquisition of Central Transmission Utility of India from POWERGRID
sum: Grid Controller of India Limited is set to acquire 100% of the equity shares of Central Transmission Utility of India Limited from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited. The transaction provides for an initial payment of ₹73.46 crore,…
detail: Grid Controller of India Limited is set to acquire 100% of the equity shares of Central Transmission Utility of India Limited from Power Grid Corporation of India Limited. The transaction provides for an initial payment of ₹73.46 crore, subject to a valuation-based true-up adjustment. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Grid Controller of India on this transaction. SAM advised on legal due diligence, drafting, negotiating and finalising the tripartite share purchase agreement, and ancillary transaction matters.
